title: AI Prompt Engineering Cheat Sheet: 100+ Prompts That Actually Work in 2026
author: Malaclyde
excerpt: Stop getting mediocre results from AI. This cheat sheet contains 100+ battle-tested prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, organized by business use case.
content:
Most people use AI tools wrong. They type a vague prompt, get a vague response, and blame the tool. The truth is: AI output quality depends almost entirely on prompt quality.

After testing thousands of prompts across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, I've compiled the 100+ that consistently produce excellent results.

What Makes a Great Prompt?

Before diving into the prompts, the framework: every great prompt includes (1) a clear role, (2) specific context, (3) format instructions, and (4) constraints. The cheat sheet explains this framework with examples.

Marketing Prompts (25)

Including: blog post outlines that actually rank, social media threads that drive engagement, email subject lines with proven open rates, landing page copy that converts at 5%+, and ad variations for A/B testing.

Sales Prompts (20)

Cold email templates that got 40%+ response rates in testing, follow-up sequences that recovered 15% of dead leads, objection handling scripts, and proposal generators.

Content Creation (25)

YouTube script frameworks (hook, body, CTA), podcast episode outlines that flow naturally, newsletter templates with 50%+ open rates, and e-book chapter structures.

Data Analysis (15)

Survey analysis prompts that find hidden insights, report generators, market research frameworks, and competitor analysis templates.

Automation (15)

Zapier/Make workflow descriptions, API integration prompts, data transformation rules, and error handling templates.

Bonus: Prompt Optimization Framework

The cheat sheet also includes a system for creating your own high-performing prompts: test, measure, iterate. You'll never accept mediocre AI outputs again.
